Fig. 3. Distributions of the system and matching gains across the three datasets. Each point shows the gains for one query sample, with the values averaged across three random seeds. Quadrant proportions were calculated separately for each subject and then averaged across subjects.

Fig. 4. Realized system and matching gains across within-subject deciles formed by ranking samples according to Ĝs and Ĝm, respectively. The points show participant-level mean gains, and the shaded regions show 95% confidence intervals obtained by bootstrapping participants. The horizontal dashed lines indicate zero gain.
